    [![](https://assets.faireconomy.media/nfs/public/5/3/0/6/9/3/2/5306932.png?_=1791539505)](https://www.dailyforex.com/forex-technical-analysis/2026/10/eurgbp-forecast-9-october-2026/250558)

    https://www.dailyforex.com/forex-technical-analysis/2026/10/eurgbp-forecast-9-october-2026/250558

    The euro continues to struggle overall, as rates in France show signs of extreme stress at the moment. The euro has rallied a little bit against the British pound after initially selling off on Thursday, as we are getting fairly close to a demand area. All things being equal, this is a market that is still paying close attention to the idea that the interest rate differential will continue to be a major factor. Ultimately, British interest rates are much higher than those in Europe. Although Europe is closing the gap, unfortunately, the Europeans are seeing higher rates due to fiscal problems.
